posts.body_html:
It is true, we likely can't stop people from unauthorized use of our photos. Actually, I encourage people to use my photos, just give me credit that is loud and clear on the listing and let me know for the love of Jesus!

That aside, the only way to deter them is to have a pinned Ebay blacklist on this site and on all other CP sites. List ALL sellers who have verified stolen photos, and then send them the link. Dimes to Dionaeas, they'll stop once they see that. We have 10's of 1000's of view on this forum every month (especially during the spring/summer), so we have leverage.

Thing is, it sucks turning this positive, mind-healing and gratifying hobby into something negative like that. We want to send out good vibes to people. Anyone else have other suggestions?
